name: carpeta-ciudadana-arquitectura
description: Documentación de arquitectura del Operador de Carpeta Ciudadana

scripts.build: npm run check && npm run md && vite build
scripts.check: node scripts/check-content.mjs && node scripts/check-contrast.mjs && node scripts/check-render.mjs && node scripts/arquitectura/check.mjs
scripts.md: node scripts/build-md.mjs && node scripts/build-diagrams.mjs && node scripts/build-png.mjs && node scripts/arquitectura/build-md.mjs && node scripts/arquitectura/build-diagramas.mjs
scripts.pdf: npm run md && node scripts/build-pdf.mjs && node scripts/build-pdf.mjs --fuente docs/arquitectura-assignment2.md --nombre arquitectura/arquitectura-carpeta-ciudadana.pdf --copia ../assignment2/arquitectura-carpeta-ciudadana.pdf
